seo_title: Find Scholarships for F- Visa Holders in USA
seo_description: Scholarships for F- visa holders in the USA. Compare eligibility, deadlines, and award details, then apply through official program pages.
intro: Trying to find USA scholarships you can actually apply for as an F-one visa holder usually means sorting past broad advice and checking which listings may fit your status. This filtered slice brings together a focused set of programs connected to international student eligibility, with rows spanning areas like education, STEM, community, medicine, arts, and more. You can compare options across study levels, from earlier college stages through graduate study, and scan fields such as engineering, business, English, health professions, and education. Awards, essay expectations, and requirement details vary by listing, and deadlines differ across the rows below, so it is worth reviewing each entry closely and checking official pages promptly.
h1: Explore Scholarships for F- Visa Holders USA
supporting: Use this list to compare more than just the scholarship title. Read the eligibility and requirement lines carefully, note whether the opportunity appears broader for international students or tied to a subject area, and check how much detail the application may require. Some listings may be lighter-touch, while others ask for more materials. If you are applying in the USA for the upcoming cycle, this is a practical place to browse, shortlist, and verify current terms directly with the provider before you submit anything.
related_intro: If these results feel too broad, related pages can help you narrow your search by study level, subject, essay preference, or other eligibility details. That makes it easier to compare similar USA scholarship options side by side instead of mixing very different programs in one shortlist.

faq.question: What kinds of scholarships can I find in this filtered set?
faq.answer: These listings span areas such as Education, STEM, Miscellaneous, Community, Medicine, and Arts, with sample fields including education, business, engineering, English, and health professions. You can also explore options across levels like graduate student, high school senior, and college year listings.

faq.question: Do all of these scholarships have the same deadline or essay requirement?
faq.answer: No. Deadlines differ by program, and some rows may be coming up soon, so check dates promptly on the listing and official page. Essay requirements are mixed as well, which means you should review each scholarship before you apply.

faq.question: Are scholarship amounts the same across this USA catalog slice?
faq.answer: No—amounts vary by listing, and not every row shows the same award format. Use the catalog to browse and compare options, then verify the exact amount, renewal terms, and any conditions on the official scholarship page.
